name: TCPL Packaging Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1987, TCPL Packaging Ltd manufactures paperboard-based packaging materials and flexible packaging products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
a) TCPL is India’s largest folding carton manufacturer and convertor of paperboard. 
b) It produces sustainable packaging solutions for customers across industries. 
c) It provides paperboard-based packaging solutions including folding cartons, printed 
blanks and outers, litho-lamination, plastic cartons, blister packs, and shelf-ready packaging. 
d) The company has also ventured into the flexible packaging industry, with capability to produce printed cork-tipping paper, laminates, 
sleeves, and wrap-around labels

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 31.0% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 18.2%
